_comment: Every number the liquid twin uses, with its source and a confidence grade.
Grades follow cfd-cabinet-cooling/FINDINGS-AU01.md: H = from a primary
document; M = derived from one, stated assumptions; C = carried forward
from a superseded source; L = engineering judgement or a placeholder.
A value of null means NOT YET KNOWN. params.py refuses to return one
rather than substituting a default, so nothing can quietly run on a
number nobody chose. See the 'pending' field for what would settle it.
From the Schneider Electric RD110 10 MW GB300 reference design, rev 3.
RD110 states four loop temperatures directly; the approach temperatures are
derived from them and marked M. Two things it does NOT settle are still null.
READ SECTION 7 OF SPEC.md BEFORE USING THESE. RD110 rejects heat with
high-temperature chillers, not dry coolers, so its 37 C facility supply is a
chiller output and carries no implication that a dry cooler can produce it.

facility_supply_c.source: Schneider Electric RD110 rev 3 (RD110DSR3-GB300.pdf), Facility Cooling + IT Space attribute tables
facility_supply_c.note: RD110 'HT chiller CW supply temperature' / 'CDU CW supply temperature'

facility_return_c.source: Schneider Electric RD110 rev 3 (RD110DSR3-GB300.pdf), Facility Cooling + IT Space attribute tables
facility_return_c.note: RD110 'HT chiller CW return temperature' / 'CDU CW return temperature'; a 10 K facility rise

tcs_supply_c.source: Schneider Electric RD110 rev 3 (RD110DSR3-GB300.pdf), Facility Cooling + IT Space attribute tables
tcs_supply_c.note: RD110 'TCS loop supply temperature' - the cold plate inlet

tcs_return_c.source: Schneider Electric RD110 rev 3 (RD110DSR3-GB300.pdf), Facility Cooling + IT Space attribute tables
tcs_return_c.note: RD110 'TCS loop return temperature'; a 10 K secondary rise, matching the facility side

cdu_approach_k.source: Schneider Electric RD110 rev 3 (RD110DSR3-GB300.pdf), Facility Cooling + IT Space attribute tables, derived
cdu_approach_k.note: TCS supply 40 minus facility supply 37. RD110 states no PHX terminal difference directly; this is what its own four temperatures imply for the Motivair MCDU-50.

drycooler_approach_k.pending: a dry cooler selection at an Australian design ambient
note: RD110 CANNOT settle this. Its baseline heat rejection is four Uniflair
XRAF4242A EHT high-temperature chillers; dry coolers with adiabatic assist
appear only in its 'Design Options' list, with no approach temperature
given. A chiller makes 37 C water at any ambient in range; a dry cooler
cannot make water colder than ambient at all. See SPEC.md section 7.1.

ambient_design_c.note: RD110's own range is -9.6 to 39.3 C for Paris and Singapore. AU01 is an Australian site and needs its own design dry bulb AND coincident wet bulb - the wet bulb is what decides whether adiabatic assist closes the gap.

ambient_range_rd110_c.source: Schneider Electric RD110 rev 3 (RD110DSR3-GB300.pdf), Facility Cooling + IT Space attribute tables
ambient_range_rd110_c.note: RD110's stated outdoor range, for its reference locations. Recorded for traceability; not AU01's.

ashrae_liquid_class.source: Schneider Electric RD110 rev 3 (RD110DSR3-GB300.pdf), Facility Cooling + IT Space attribute tables, derived
ashrae_liquid_class.note: A 37 C facility supply sits in the W40 band (W32 tops out at 32 C, W40 at 40 C). RD110 does not name a class itself.

cold_plate_max_inlet_c.pending: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / node vendor limit
cold_plate_max_inlet_c.note: RD110's 40 C TCS supply is the DESIGN value, not the allowable maximum. The margin between them is what every hot-day verdict is judged against, and RD110 does not state it.

note: Still open, and RD110 sharpens the question rather than answering it.
RD110 states 87 % liquid / 13 % air - but for a 142 kW GB300 NVL72 rack,
not the B300 nodes in cfd-cabinet-cooling. AU01's own figures, 68 kW liquid
and 36.75 kW air, imply 65 %. Both cannot describe the same machine, and
the 22-point gap is roughly a factor of three on the air load. Recorded
under plant.rd110 so the two can be compared without being merged.

cdu_standing_loss_kw.source: midpoint of the 10-25 kW range in AU013-143-cooling-check.md

rating_point._comment: PENDING a dry cooler selection. Ambient and approach here must agree with temperatures.ambient_design_c.

pumps._comment: Head curve as three datasheet points: shutoff, duty, runout. components.PumpCurve.from_points fits the quadratic.

properties_source.note: See dtloop/fluid.py. Generic glycol data, NOT a datasheet for the AU01 fill. Replace before quoting pressure drop to a vendor.

design_velocity_ms.note: typical closed-loop sizing velocity; used only to sanity-check DN selections

reference_pressure_pa.note: expansion vessel setting. Fixes the absolute level of an otherwise closed loop; no flow depends on it.

note: A shut valve is a large finite resistance, never infinite: an infinite K
gives a singular Jacobian, and pruning the branch would throw away the
thermal states whose temperature the demo needs to show rising.
At 1e10 a 1 bar drop passes 3e-3 kg/s - 0.03 % of a nominal 10 kg/s -
while keeping the system conditioned well inside float64.
